1	GPT-4 Technical Report (excerpt)
     2	=================================
     3	
     4	GPT-4 is a large multimodal model that can accept image and text inputs
     5	and produce text outputs. While less capable than humans in many real-world
     6	scenarios, GPT-4 exhibits human-level performance on various professional
     7	and academic benchmarks. For example, it passes a simulated bar exam with
     8	a score around the top 10% of test takers. GPT-4 was trained using both
     9	publicly available data and data licensed from third-party providers, and
    10	then fine-tuned with reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF).
    11	
    12	Capabilities
    13	------------
    14	GPT-4 demonstrates strong abilities across a wide variety of tasks:
    15	- writing, summarization, translation
    16	- answering questions in multiple subjects (law, medicine, biology, etc.)
    17	- solving math word problems
    18	- writing and explaining code in many programming languages
    19	- reasoning over images and tables (multimodal input)
    20	- following complex multi-step instructions
    21	
    22	The researchers think GPT-4 is important because it represents a significant
    23	advance over GPT-3.5: it scores higher on standardized tests, makes fewer
    24	factual mistakes, and can handle longer context windows. They also developed
    25	a predictable scaling methodology, where smaller models can be used to
    26	forecast certain capabilities of the much larger model.
    27	
    28	Limitations
    29	-----------
    30	GPT-4 is not perfect. Like earlier systems, it can:
    31	- "hallucinate" facts (generate confident but incorrect statements)
    32	- make reasoning errors and fail at simple math
    33	- be sensitive to small changes in prompts
    34	- lack knowledge of events after its training cutoff
    35	- exhibit social biases or be persuaded into harmful outputs
    36	
    37	The authors stress that GPT-4 should be used carefully, with humans in the
    38	loop for high-stakes decisions, and that more research is needed to make
    39	the model safer and more reliable.
